meta.temperature_K_convention: Pair is [min_K, max_K]. Use 999 (or any value ≥ 500) for max to mean no practical upper bound in the matcher.

general.description: Low-lying photosynthetic organisms that form tightly bonded colonies on rocky and metallic surfaces. The organism partially embeds into subsurface rock layers for protection, exposing only photosynthetic proto-leaves. Their evolution is primitive but highly successful, making them one of the most common xenobiological genera.
environmental_context: Found on rocky and high metal content planets
Often forms wide flat colonies across terrain surfaces
Frequently embedded partially into rock substrate
Highly dependent on mineral composition of surrounding terrain

color_variants.rule: Color is determined by a combination of parent star type and local mineral composition (hybrid system unique to this genus)

species.description: Octopoid-like structure with semi-translucent domes and exposed photosynthetic tentacle-like extensions.
Elongated ovoid formations connected across terrain, forming linear biological chains.
Concentric ring-patterned organism with mottled proto-leaf structures in darker hues.
Broad interconnected ridge structures optimized for low-temperature environments.
Layered plateau-like organism forming overlapping mineral-rich sheets.
Separated ovoid surface projections linked to a larger subterranean organism.
Vine-like overlapping growths with irregular banded coloration patterns.
Thick rock-like biological structure covered in irregular photosynthetic lattice cells.

matchContextNotes: Morph colour follows genus meta.color_variants (star type). Example: Turquoise variant on L-type host stars (L → Turquoise in the mapping).
Codex entry id suffix in journals often encodes colour (e.g. stratumtectonicasturquoise) — not a separate species row.

stratum_tectonicas_star_colours.note: Tectonicas shares the genus-wide star→colour table in meta.color_variants.mapping (e.g. L dwarf → Turquoise, M → Green, T → Grey).

authorNotes.gravity_constraints: None explicitly defined, but implicitly constrained by planetary generation rules
special_rules: Minimum sample distance is 500m due to wide colony spread
All species require thin atmosphere conditions
Temperature is a primary species differentiator within CO2/SO2 systems
Stratum tectonicas is the only High Metal Content exclusive species
Color is partially star-based but also influenced by mineral composition
Colony structures are surface expressions of partially embedded organisms
Species identification depends heavily on temperature bracket + atmosphere combination
Stratum is one of the most mechanically segmented genera in Elite exobiology
Stratum tectonicas: turquoise morph is the valid L-type (brown dwarf) colour variant per meta.color_variants — same species id as other tectonicas colours.
